headline: Solar Panels Without Batteries, Plants Shut Down and Projects Delayed. The Recipe for Romania's Energy Crisis
summary: Romania has invested billions in renewable capacity, but solar panels without batteries leave evening supply reliant on other sources. Plants have shut down and projects have been delayed.
why: Power supply reliability affects industrial costs and energy-sector investment. Renewable projects depend on storage and grid planning to deliver output when demand peaks.
